p1.scene: Two pictures of the same kitchen. Left: the examiner's picture. Right: your picture.
p1.examiner: Look at the two pictures. Here the clock says three o'clock, but here it says four o'clock. What other differences can you see?
differences: In your picture the cat is on the chair, but in my picture it is under the table.
In your picture there are two cups on the table, but in my picture there are three cups.
In your picture the window is open, but in my picture it is closed.
In your picture the boy has got a blue T-shirt, but in my picture it is green.
In your picture there is a bowl of apples, but in my picture there is a bowl of bananas.

p2.title: Sam and the kite
p2.examiner_open: These pictures show a story. It's called 'Sam and the kite'. Look at the pictures first. Sam is in the park with his new kite. It's a windy day and he is very happy. Now you tell the story.
frames: Sam is in the park with his new red kite. It's very windy and the kite flies high in the sky.
Suddenly the wind is too strong. The string breaks and the kite flies away over the trees.
Sam runs after the kite. He finds it in a big tree, but it's too high. He is sad.
A tall man with a ladder helps Sam. He gets the kite down and Sam says 'Thank you!'

p1: Part One. Look at the picture. Listen and look. There is one example.
Look at this photo, Grandma. It's our picnic in the park last Sunday.
What a lovely day! Who's the girl with glasses? She's reading a map.
That's Kim. She wanted to walk to the waterfall.
Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.
And who's the boy carrying that big bag?
That's Nick. The bag is full of apples. He picked them at the farm.
Is that man playing the guitar?
Yes, under the tree. That's Paul, Kim's dad. He's wearing a hat because it was very sunny.
Can you see the woman with the camera?
The one taking photos of the lake?
Yes. That's Mary, my teacher. She took hundreds of photos!
Look at that boy near the water. What's he doing?
He's flying his kite. That's Ben. It was a windy day, so the kite went very high.
Oh yes! I can see it.
And the girl on the blanket? She's got a puppy!
That's Jane. The puppy is called Rex. He's only two months old.
Now listen to Part One again.
p2: Part Two. Listen and look. There is one example.
Listen, children. Next Friday we're going to the farm.
Great, Miss Green! Are we going by train?
No, we're going by bus. It leaves at nine o'clock.
Can you see the answer? Now you listen and write.
What's the farm called, Miss Green?
Lake. L-A-K-E. There's a big lake next to it.
Are there lots of animals at the farm?
Yes. The farmer says there are forty-six animals: cows, sheep, goats and horses.
Yes, and they all need food every day.
Can we give food to the cows?
No, the cows are too big. But we can give food to the goats. They love carrots.
Where are we going to have our picnic?
Next to the river. There are some tables under the trees there.
Next to the river. Can we swim?
No, the water is too cold!
What do we need to bring?
Your lunch and a hat. It's very sunny today.
A hat. OK, I've got a big blue one.
Now listen to Part Two again.
p3: Part Three. Listen and look. There is one example.
Mr Green is telling Jim about the people in his family and their favourite hobbies. What is each person's favourite hobby?
Hello, Mr Green. Is that your sister in the photo?
Yes, that's my sister. She loves dancing. She goes to a dance class every Saturday evening and she never stops moving!
Can you see the letter H? Now you listen and write a letter in each box.
That's my grandmother. She's eighty-two, but she still makes dinner for all the family every Sunday. Cooking is her favourite hobby. Her soup is the best in the world!
This is my uncle. He lives next to a river and he goes there every morning with his boat.
Does he catch a lot of fish?
Sometimes! Fishing is the thing he likes most. He can sit quietly for hours.
Yes, she's ten. She goes to the pool three times a week. She can swim really fast, on her front and on her back. She wants to be a swimming teacher.
And here's my brother. He's got a new bike and he rides it in the mountains every weekend.
Yes, but he loves it. Riding his bike is his favourite thing in the world.
That's my cousin. He's always got his camera with him. He takes photos of birds, flowers, the lake… everything! Taking photos is his hobby.
Now listen to Part Three again.
p4: Part Four. Look at the pictures. Listen and look. There is one example.
What does Fred want for lunch?
Fred, what would you like for lunch? A sandwich?
No thanks, Mum. Can I have some pizza?
Pizza again! All right. And a piece of cake after.
Can you see the tick? Now you listen and tick the box.
One. What is Vicky wearing today?
Vicky, are you wearing your new dress to the party?
No, it's too hot for a dress. I'm wearing my yellow T-shirt.
Two. What did Anna see at the zoo?
Did you see the pandas at the zoo, Anna?
No, Dad. The pandas slept all day. But I saw a kangaroo! It jumped very high.
There aren't any dolphins at that zoo.
Three. What is Jack doing now?
Where's Jack? Is he reading in his room?
No, he's sleeping. He was very tired after football.
Sleeping? But it's only six o'clock! I'm cooking his dinner.
Let him sleep for an hour.
Four. How did Sam go to school this morning?
Did you go to school by bus this morning, Sam?
No, Mum. The bus was late, so I went by bike.
By bike? Dad wanted to take you in the car.
I know, but I was quicker!
Five. What did Mum buy at the shop?
Mum, did you buy carrots for the soup?
No, they didn't have any. And there weren't any potatoes.
Now listen to Part Four again.
p5: Part Five. Look at the picture. Listen and look. There is one example.
Can you colour this picture of the picnic by the lake?
Yes! Can I colour the towel on the rock?
Can you see the orange towel? This is an example. Now you listen and colour and write.
Now, can you see the boat on the lake?
Yes, the small one near the boy.
Can I colour a cloud now?
Yes. Colour the cloud above the tent. Make it grey, like a rainy cloud.
Look at the boy. He's got a fish in his hand!
Can I do some writing too?
Yes. Can you see the girl's kite? Write the word 'sunny' on it. S-U-N-N-Y.
And now the dog's ball. Can you see it next to the tent?
Yes. Can I colour it red?
Now listen to Part Five again.
